points.text: You pass 4 of 6 discipline checks. The first miss is the remaining ASHOKLEY shares, which have an exit signal but no order. action: At Monday's open close the ADANIENSOL and HYUNDAI put spreads, sell the call only if red still holds, and sell the last 13 ASHOKLEY shares.
